subject: Project Kestrel kickoff — LLM-generated parallel data beats web crawl
body:
Hi Daniela,

Kicking off the NewsPaLM effort — internal codename is Project Kestrel, please use it in docs and OKR entries so the workstream is trackable across the portfolio.

Basis: our open-source NewsPaLM MBR/QE release. The dataset is LLM-generated parallel data for en-de and de-en, produced three ways — MBR-decoded, QE-reranked, and greedy-decoded — at both sentence level and multi-sentence blob level. The headline claim we're operationalizing: this curated generated data outperforms traditional web-crawled parallel data for training.

Kestrel deliverables: (1) reproduce the data-quality claim inside our training stack, (2) a decision memo on replacing a slice of our web-crawled de-en corpus with MBR-decoded data, (3) a recipe for extending beyond en/de. Milestones: eval harness by mid-March, ablations by end of April, memo before 05-25.

Staffing note from you when ready.

Dmitri
